wholePhysicalScope: Current building envelopes and positions follow the five native OpenStreetMap ways and the public 2023 USDA ortho.
lodDetails: The runtime detail levels preserve the blockhouse, guardhouse, officers houses and visitor center.
limitations: Wall heights, minor apertures and fine timber decoration were proportioned using the documented building types. The historic floor plans and interiors are outside the current model scope.
All five present buildings are represented. The many removed post structures remain absent.
